title: 0x26 Chain execution cases

cases.observations: Matching DAG commit-log hashes and block and intent counts accompanied different execution roots. The first different root was recorded at height 171.
cases.partial_flush_condition: If verified_count equals local pending_queue_length, drain the full verified prefix; otherwise drain only a multiple of the batch size.
cases.replacement_rule: Drain verified_count - (verified_count % batch_size), then execute groups of batch_size.
cases.illustration: At batch size eight, one replica can flush two groups of four while another executes one group of eight. This is an illustrative schedule, not a recovered runtime trace.

cases.input_gap: Replay used independent local mark and index prices. Price differences could change order acceptance.
cases.mechanism: Carry oracle observations in the signed payload and derive replay maps from those observations.
cases.merged_selection: Select the newest timestamp per market and price kind.
cases.compatibility_path: An empty observation payload falls back to local maps.
regression_shapes: Different local oracle maps, same pinned payload.
Fresh observation followed by a stale observation in a merged body.
cases.other_input_coverage: Direct cancel and replace operations require coverage by the replicated-input contract.

partition_lemma.statement: For a common sequence S, starting offset o, and fixed b > 0, FIFO drains of multiples of b emit group j = S[o+jb:o+(j+1)b].
partition_lemma.proof: After k groups, the consumed offset is o+kb. A drain of m groups emits exactly the next m consecutive groups and advances the offset to o+(k+m)b. Induction establishes the claim. A stall emits no group.
partition_lemma.scope: Agreement for common successfully executed group indices, within one common execution segment. Equal wall-clock progress is not required.

restart_analysis.durable_offset: No consumed Mahi-sequence offset or batch-size version is stored in CommitMeta or the engine snapshot.
restart_analysis.scope: A common fresh segment requires boundary agreement. Staggered restart and catch-up are not covered by the within-segment lemma.
restart_analysis.tail_blocks: The restarted replica discards volatile DAG and pending-execution references. No stored DAG-tail replay restores the same blocks. Below-boundary blocks are rejected.

payload_recovery.admitted_wal: Restore admitted intents from mempool WAL, prune already-consumed nonces, then eligible requests can be proposed in new DAG blocks.
payload_recovery.pre_admitted_only: The process-local pool removes requests on producer drain. No guaranteed local recovery exists for payloads held only there or in the volatile DAG.
payload_recovery.conclusion: Request recovery is conditional on retained admission state. It does not restore the original DAG blocks or grouping.

restart_analysis.quorum_three: A missing validator stalls new prior-round quorum formation. It does not stop already-queued execution or certify a common restart segment.

tail_analysis.conditional_wait_bound: (b-r)*Delta + E, assuming a bound Delta on additions to the ordered verified prefix and E on completion execution.

oracle_trust.selection: Newest timestamp; >= replaces the earlier equal-timestamp observation.
oracle_trust.cross_validator_aggregation: This replay path has no validator median or oracle quorum check.
oracle_trust.threat: A Byzantine block author can supply a false positive price with a newer timestamp. Ordering the input does not establish its truth.

execution_error_behavior.application_error: Requeue the failed merged group and unexecuted suffix at the queue front in original order. Stop the pass and retry.
execution_error_behavior.lemma_condition: Successful execution or a state-preserving retry. Failure atomicity is not proved by the partition lemma.

alternative_grouping.proposal: Use each nonempty committed leader sub-DAG as an execution group, under common leader decisions and canonical deduplication.
alternative_grouping.benefit: Removes the fixed-count tail and modulo-b offset.
alternative_grouping.remaining_recovery_metadata: Last applied leader and deduplication frontier, or equivalent checkpoint.
alternative_grouping.recorded_design_choice: Run 71 selected count eight for overhead amortization in a local count sweep.

application_error_contract: Requeueing preserves queue order. Canonical application state is not guaranteed unchanged on error; the outer durable wrapper does not inspect the inner Result. See anc/application-contracts.json.
